# Johnny Boursiquot

> Software engineer with over two decades of building and running production systems, on startup founding teams and inside large technology companies. Co-founder and CTO of Skilltype. Works across AI systems, cloud architecture, distributed systems, and reliability engineering. Also a conference keynote speaker and instructor, with courses on O'Reilly, LinkedIn Learning, and Packt.

Last updated: 2026-09-28. Contact: message on LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/jboursiquot).

Focus areas: AI systems (LLM-powered and agentic features in production), cloud architecture, distributed and data systems, reliability engineering, and engineering leadership.

Facts, with dates where they matter:

- Roles, most recent first, with length: Director of Technology, Human Agency (3 mos); Principal Software Engineer and Program Lead, Chick-fil-A via Stable Kernel (1 yr 1 mo); Co-founder and CTO (fractional), Skilltype (6 yrs 11 mos); Platform Observability Engineer, Salesforce (1 yr 11 mos); Site Reliability Engineer, Heroku (2 yrs); Principal Cloud Engineer, The Achievement Network (2 yrs 10 mos); Senior Software Engineer, InfluxData (4 mos); Software Architect and Principal Software Engineer, One Door; Software Engineering Instructor, Launch Academy; Engineering leadership roles, MAARK.
- Founder of Idiomat LLC, a software engineering training and consulting company (https://idiomat.co/).
- Software engineer for over two decades; earlier roles before MAARK are not listed.
- GopherCon: program chair; workshop instructor at GopherCon US, EU, and Singapore (most recently August 2026); closing keynotes 2019 and 2021; emcee 2024 and 2026.
- Go Time podcast (Changelog Media): host, 2017 to December 2024. The show ended with its final episode in December 2024; he is no longer hosting a podcast.
- Contributing author, 97 Things Every SRE Should Know (O'Reilly).
- Most recent public engagements: August 2026 at GopherCon US (moderator: A Slice of Go's Future; emcee; host: United Go Meetup; instructor: Agents the Hard Way: Building Agentic Systems in Go).
- Education: M.S., Cloud Computing Architecture, University of Maryland Global Campus; B.S., Computer and Information Science, University of Maryland Global Campus.

## Experience

- [Human Agency](https://www.humanagency.com/): Director of Technology, 3 mos. Led engineering for an AI platform launch, including SOC 2 readiness and commercial controls.
- [Chick-fil-A](https://www.chick-fil-a.com/): Principal Software Engineer and Program Lead, 1 yr 1 mo. Lead architecture and delivery for Chick-fil-A's Loyalty Platform initiatives.
- [Skilltype](https://www.skilltype.com/): Co-founder and CTO (fractional), 6 yrs 11 mos. Own product direction and engineering for library talent-management software, from concept through launch.
- [Salesforce](https://www.salesforce.com/): Platform Observability Engineer, 1 yr 11 mos. Wrote shared Go instrumentation libraries for OpenTelemetry adoption and led the move to Honeycomb and distributed tracing.
- [Heroku](https://www.heroku.com/): Site Reliability Engineer, 2 yrs. Built tooling and incident-response workflows, and served as incident commander during major incidents.
- [The Achievement Network](https://achievementnetwork.org/): Principal Cloud Engineer, 2 yrs 10 mos. Led backend engineering and AWS modernization for an education SaaS product.
- [InfluxData](https://influxdata.com/): Senior Software Engineer, 4 mos. Worked on distributed time-series database infrastructure and enterprise SaaS services in Go.
- [One Door](https://onedoor.com/): Software Architect and Principal Software Engineer. Built retail-merchandising SaaS applications, APIs, and messaging.
- [Launch Academy](https://www.launchacademy.com/): Software Engineering Instructor. Taught Ruby on Rails and web application development, and mentored new engineers.
- [MAARK](https://www.maark.com/): Engineering leadership roles. Owned products from concept through launch, hired engineers, and built enterprise SaaS, payments, and web applications.
- [Earlier roles](https://www.jboursiquot.com/): Software engineer. Additional software engineering roles preceded MAARK.
